name: BOD
summary: Beta-methoxy analogue of 2C-D, reports indicate it to be a more "mild" than the likes of 2C-x and DOx compounds. Reports on the bodyload are highly variable amongst users. Some experience an intense bodyload while others barely feel anything at all.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: BOD shows high affinity for the serotonin 5-HT2A and 5-HT2C receptors (Ki = 1.38 nM and 19.74 nM, respectively). It produces the head-twitch response, a behavioral proxy of psychedelic effects, in rodents.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

uses.text: It is the β-methoxy derivative of 2C-D. The drug is taken orally. BOD has been encountered as a novel designer drug.

sideEffects.en: Reports in people are few and vary a lot, especially over how heavy it feels in the body. Psychedelics of this family can cause nausea, anxiety, a raised heart rate and blood pressure, and confusion.
sideEffects.zh: 關於它在人體的回報很少，差異也很大，尤其是身體負擔的感受。這個家族的迷幻藥可能造成噁心、焦慮、心跳與血壓上升以及混亂。
sideEffects.zhHans: 关于它在人体的回报很少，差异也很大，尤其是身体负担的感受。这个家族的迷幻药可能造成恶心、焦虑、心跳与血压上升以及混乱。

fact.en: BOD is the beta methoxy version of 2C-D, part of the BOx series that Alexander Shulgin explored. Adding that oxygen on the side chain changes the effect in ways chemists are still mapping.
fact.zh: BOD 是 2C-D 的 β 甲氧基版本，屬於 Alexander Shulgin 探索過的 BOx 系列。在側鏈上加入那個氧會改變作用，其方式至今仍在被化學家釐清。
fact.zhHans: BOD 是 2C-D 的 β 甲氧基版本，属于 Alexander Shulgin 探索过的 BOx 系列。在侧链上加入那个氧会改变作用，其方式至今仍在被化学家厘清。
